voices.note: the school of Rav, transmitting a rival version of his ruling

props.gloss_en: one who concealed the knife between the two simanim and severed the lower one -- his slaughter is not valid
Rav's ruling on a knife concealed beneath the hide, as Rav Yehuda transmits it: the slaughter is valid
Rav's ruling on a knife concealed beneath the hide, as the school of Rav transmit it: 'I do not know'
mishna: if one concealed the knife beneath the second siman and severed it, R' Yeshevav says the animal is a neveila (carcass)
mishna: if one concealed the knife beneath the second siman and severed it, R' Akiva says the animal is a tereifa
the novelty of Rav's ruling over the mishna: even concealing top-down, in the manner of slaughter, disqualifies -- from the mishna alone one might have limited chalada to bottom-up cutting

questions.gloss_en: per Bei Rav's uncertainty about the hide: a knife concealed beneath a cloth on the neck -- what is the halakha?
per Bei Rav's uncertainty about the hide: a knife concealed beneath tangled wool on the neck -- what is the halakha?
one who concealed the knife while cutting the final minority of the simanim (the majority already validly cut) -- what is the halakha?

queries.subject: rav
queries.label_en: What does rav hold? (by transmitting tradition)
